title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23 year old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after attacking three five year old boys at a childcare centre in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. Using a knife with a blade of about 8.5 centimetres, he seriously wounded all three children. One boy needed emergency surgery after a major vein in his neck was cut, another suffered two chest stabs that damaged his heart and arteries and barely survived, and the third was injured in his ear and lung. A daycare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, after which he dropped the knife and was held by passersby until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and choosing children as targets. He bought four kitchen knives, studied anatomical diagrams, and purchased raw beef on 30 September to practise stabbing. The prosecution describes the act as exceptionally cold blooded and is demanding a 15 year prison sentence and a 15 year expulsion from Switzerland. The case is now before the court in Zurich, where the defendant appeared on Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
